Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for
the applicant.
2. Mr. Sandeep Sharma, learned AGA for the State.
3. The instant second bail application has been
moved on behalf of the applicant - "Ramesh Singh @
Pappu, son of Bishan Singh", for seeking bail in
connection with FIR dated 22.03.2023 bearing FIR No.
159 of 2023, registered at Police Station - Kashipur,
District - Udham Singh Nagar wherein present
applicant has been implicated and charge sheeted for
offences punishable under Section 302, 201 IPC.
4. This is second bail application and the first bail
application was rejected by this Court on 25.03.2025.
5. Now, the instant second bail application has
been moved on the ground of long incarceration as
well as on the ground that there is no substantial
progress in the trial.
6. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the
applicant that applicant is languishing in jail since
04.07.2024 and suffered long incarceration of more
than 2 years and is a senior citizen of 65 years and has
no criminal antecedents.
7. Apart from this, he submits that there is no
substantial progress in the trial, since out of 18
prosecution witness uptil date only 7 prosecution
witnesses have been examined, therefore, there is no
possibility that trial would be expedited soon.
8. On the other side, Mr. Sharma, learned AGA for
the State have not disputed that applicant is
languishing in jail since 04.07.2024 and there is no
substantial progress in the trial, since uptil date, only 7
prosecution witnesses have been examined out of 18
prosecution witnesses and applicant has no criminal

antecedents.
9. After hearing the learned counsel for the parties
and taking into consideration that applicant already
suffered long incarceration of more than 2 years and
there is no substantial progress in the trial and
applicant has no criminal antecedents, this Court is of
the view that the applicant deserves for bail.
10. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on
the merit of the case, the instant second bail
application is allowed.
11. Let the applicant "Ramesh Singh @ Pappu, son
of Bishan Singh" be released on bail, on executing
personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties,
each of like amount, to the satisfaction of Court
concerned, subject the following conditions:-
i. After being released on bail, the applicant
shall join the trial Court proceedings on each and
every date without seeking any unnecessary
adjournment.
ii. The applicant shall surrender his passport, if
any, within one week from the date of his release and
shall not leave the country without prior permission of
the Court.
iii. The applicant shall not give any threatening
to the informant, victim's family or witnesses and will
not make any attempt to temper with the evidence.
